python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
cfg = json.loads(Path('scheduler_lab/schedule_config.yaml').read_text())
run = json.loads(Path('scheduler_lab/out/run_report.json').read_text())
order = [job['job_id'] for job in cfg['jobs']]
report = {
    'jobs': cfg['jobs'],
    'dependency_order': order,
    'run_revision': run['revision'],
    'outcomes': run['results'],
}
out = Path('scheduler_lab/out/data_schedule_report.json')
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(out.read_text())
# Validate the report and compare required task fields.
check = json.loads(out.read_text())
assert check['run_revision'] == 1
assert check['dependency_order'] == ['extract_orders', 'clean_orders', 'publish_margin', 'archive_close']
assert len(check['jobs']) == len(check['outcomes']) == 4
PY
